data.title: Lossless video compression using Bloom filters
data.author: rh3939
data.article_summary: 这篇文章主要介绍了一个名为 "new_bloom_filter_repo" 的代码库，由用户 "ross39" 创建并公开。该库目前有23个星标（Star），但尚未被其他开发者 fork（复制）。文章还提到，要更改通知设置，用户必须登录。文中没有详细描述代码库的具体功能或内容，仅提供了关于其基本状态的信息。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：基于Bloom滤镜的新型视频压缩方法的有效性、适用场景及其与其他传统压缩方法的比较。

不同观点：
• **antirez**：支持该方法，认为通过记录两帧之间像素变化的位置（使用位图和Bloom滤镜）可以有效压缩视频。他还提出可以进一步优化，通过设置标志位来进一步压缩连续帧之间的变化。
• **meatmanek**：质疑该方法在原始视频输入上的效果，认为该方法依赖于“大部分像素在连续帧之间变化不大”的假设，在实际含有噪声的视频中可能不成立。他还指出，经过压缩-解压缩循环的视频（如YouTube视频）可能会更适合该方法，因为噪声被去除。
• **meindnoch**：通过引用数据指出，这种新压缩方法在某些情况下比GZIP效果更差，对该方法的普适性提出质疑。
• **bob1029**：支持该方法，并通过比较JPEG/MPEG的压缩原理，解释了该方法在处理低密度1位的二进制字符串时的效率优势。
• **hxtk**：对代码实现中的某些部分感到困惑，认为该方法可能是有损的，因为某些像素变化会被舍弃，从而影响最终的压缩结果。
• **rh3939**（作者）：回应反馈，承认当前方法在处理色彩空间转换时存在精度损失，但报告了一些初步的测试结果，显示在某些情况下该方法的压缩比优于JPEG2000和H.265等传统方法。作者计划继续优化算法，并解决当前的局限性。
• **clayhacks**：询问最佳、平均和最差压缩比的具体例子，以更好地理解该方法的性能范围。
• **Dwedit**：指出H.264等编解码器也可以在无损模式下运行，只是不常见，暗示现有方法已经可以实现类似效果。
• **vintermann**：认为对于稀疏的二进制字符串，传统方法可能比Bloom滤镜更有效。
• **oivey**：建议将该方法与YouTube视频的平均字节大小进行比较，以更全面地评估其效果，并指出如果该方法是有损的，应该与有损算法进行比较。
• **less_less**：建议使用二进制融合滤镜或其他类似方法来提高空间使用效率，而不是使用Bloom滤镜。
• **chungy**：对README中的描述感到困惑，询问该方法是针对重新压缩已有的H.264视频还是用于全新视频的压缩，并指出如果是对已压缩视频进行再压缩，结果仍会有损。
• **mxfh**：质疑无损压缩在消费级应用中的意义，认为如果输入视频已经过YouTube等平台的转码处理，无损压缩的效益不大，并分享了在视频归档中尝试高比特率转码的经验。
• **ggm**：提出关于计算成本、流处理适用性、现代数据流中的压缩比以及该方法是否属于已知压缩子类的疑问。

补充讨论：
• 该方法在处理色彩空间转换时的精度问题和潜在的精度损失被多次提及，尤其是rh3939和hxtk的评论。
• 关于该方法的适用场景存在争议，一些人如meatmanek和mxfh认为其在处理原始视频或有噪声视频时效果可能不佳，而antirez和rh3939则对其在某些特定情况下的效果表示乐观。
• 对该方法的性能评估标准存在不同意见，部分人如meindnoch和oivey认为需要更全面的数据和比较来得出结论。
• 关于该方法是否为全新方法，还是已有类似方法（如二进制融合滤镜）的变种，也存在讨论，如less_less和ggm的评论。

data.title: Get PC BIOS back on UEFI only system
data.author: bonki
data.article_summary: CSMWrap 是一个让 UEFI 仅支持系统重新使用传统 PC BIOS 的工具。它通过利用 SeaBIOS 项目的 CSM 模块和 VESA BIOS 来模拟传统 BIOS 环境，目前可以引导 FreeDOS、Windows XP 和 Windows 7。使用时需将 `csmwrap.efi` 作为启动加载器放置于 EFI 分区，并关闭 Secure Boot 和 Above 4G Decoding。该工具依赖 EFI_LEGACY_REGION2_PROTOCOL 解锁传统内存区域，因此并非所有系统都支持。此外，Windows XP/7 的视频模式设置可能导致屏幕闪烁或黑屏问题，未来或将修复。主要技术来自 SeaBIOS、Nyu-EFI 和 EDK2 等项目。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：通过改造和使用传统BIOS或VGA BIOS在现代硬件上运行 legacy 操作系统（如FreeDOS、Windows XP/7）的可行性与技术挑战。

不同观点：
• [userbinator] 认为该项目类似于Hackintosh社区早期通过bootloaders在传统BIOS系统上启动UEFI macOS的逆向操作。他指出，现代GPU可能无法像传统VGA一样与通用VGA BIOS兼容，并建议开发一个"retrofit VBIOS"。他还提到，使用旧的闭源UEFI BIOS中的CSM（Compatibility Support Module）可能会在某些边缘情况下提高兼容性。

• [mmastrac] 关注Windows XP/7的视频模式设置逻辑，指出其可能使用不兼容的int10h模式，导致屏幕闪烁或黑屏，并希望了解更多相关信息。他还提到一个可能的VGA驱动代码库作为参考。

• [3036e4] 对在现代硬件上运行FreeDOS的可能性表示兴奋，认为这种代码可能有助于在某些系统上实现FreeDOS的安装。

• [LukeShu] 认为，除了BIOS相关问题，现代硬件在运行legacy操作系统时还会遇到其他挑战，例如非GPT磁盘布局的支持问题。

• [fuzzfactor] 对该项目表示赞赏，认为这是一个长期需要的解决方案，并提到替换CSM（Compatibility Support Module）的需求，认为该项目正好满足了这一需求。

• [coolcoder613] 表示他长期以来一直在寻找这样的项目，很高兴看到它的存在。

• [o11c] 指出GitHub在处理来自其他平台的子模块时表现不佳。

• [kotaKat] 希望有人能解决旧机器上的eMMC支持问题，作为下一步的发展方向。

• [ehutch79] 对kotaKat的建议表示不解，询问其原因。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是现代GPU是否能通过通用VGA BIOS实现兼容，[userbinator] 认为需要开发一个专门的"retrofit VBIOS"。
• 另一个讨论点是运行legacy操作系统的其他挑战，如磁盘布局问题([LukeShu])。
• 技术实现的细节也是一个讨论重点，例如Windows XP/7的视频模式设置逻辑([mmastrac])。
• 对GitHub在处理子模块方面的批评([o11c])以及对未来发展的期望([kotaKat])。

总体来看，讨论围绕如何在现代硬件上运行legacy操作系统展开，涉及BIOS、VGA BIOS、GPU兼容性、CSM模块及未来可能的发展方向。

CSMWrap
CSMWrap is a cool little hack that brings back the good old PC BIOS on those fancy-pants UEFI-only systems. It utilises the CSM (Compatibility Support Module) and VESA VBIOS from
SeaBIOS project
to emulate a legacy BIOS environment.
Current Status
Right now, CSMWrap can:
Boot FreeDOS, Windows XP, and Windows 7 in QEMU (both q35 and piix4 machines)
Run on some real hardware too! (Your mileage may vary)
Implementation Details
CSMWrap works by:
Unlocking the legacy BIOS memory region (0xC0000-0xFFFFF)
Loading the SeaBIOS CSM module into memory
Configuring memory mapping for legacy applications
Setting up VGA BIOS with information from EFI GOP
Building an E820 memory map based on EFI memory map
Providing essential compatibility tables (ACPI, SMBIOS)
Initializing the CSM module and legacy services
Transferring control to the legacy boot process
How to Use
Simply use
csmwarp.efi
as your bootloader, you can place it in your EFI partition and boot from it. Remember to disable Secure Boot, and Above 4G Decoding in your BIOS/UEFI settings.
Limitations
Above 4G Decoding
It is almost required to run CSMWrap with above 4G decoding disabled in your BIOS/UEFI. As UEFI firmwares are likely to place GPU's VRAM BAR above 4G, and legacy BIOS are 32bit which means it can only access the first 4G of memory.
Legacy Region Unlocking
Currently csmwrap relies on
EFI_LEGACY_REGION2_PROTOCOL
to enable writing to the legacy region. This is not available on all systems. For system that do not support this protocol, csmwrap will attempt to use PAM registers in chipset to perform decoding, which is not guaranteed to work.
Windows Video Modesetting Issues
Windows XP/7's video modesetting logic is a bit mysterious. It may try to set a incompatible mode using
int10h
, which will cause flickering or even black screen after transferring control to the legacy OS.
This is a known issue and may be fixed in the future.
Meanwhile you can try to inject the GPU driver to OS image to avoid using the VESA BIOS.
Credits

for the CSM module and VESA VBIOS
Nyu-EFI
for EFI C runtime, build system, and headers
EDK2
for code snippets
@CanonKong for test feedback and general knowledge

data.title: Iron Spring PL/I Compiler
data.author: bilegeek
data.article_summary: Iron Spring Software发布了其跨平台PL/I编译器的1.4.0版本，主要更新包括支持数组表达式，并增加了一个新的列表选项"-ln"用于显示过程和代码块中的语句嵌套。此外，还包含其他可用性增强和修复。该编译器支持Linux和OS/2系统。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于PL/I编程语言的历史、现状及其实用性的讨论。

不同观点：
• **vincent-manis**：对PL/I有感情，但指出其历史设计问题，如多任务处理、过程调用开销大、预处理器难以调试等。尽管存在这些问题，如果需要现在写PL/I代码，还是可以接受的。同时提到过去使用PL/I的糟糕经历。
• **skissane**：质疑为何PL/I支持OS/2却不支持Windows，认为现在推出商业版会非常困难，建议开源以避免个人开发风险，并提到当前市场的变化。
• **shrubble**：提到MULTICS系统和其PL/I编译器，提供了开放源代码和模拟器的链接，指出可以通过该途径体验PL/I。
• **pdw**：提到Iron Spring Software在2007年开始开发OS/2上的PL/I编译器，对开发时间表示惊讶。
• **trealira**：表示对PL/I有兴趣，因为大学书籍中提到过，但一直缺乏可用的编译器，感谢找到一个可用的编译器。
• **kjellsbells**：认为PL/I这样的小众计算领域有其价值，提到一些小众公司和项目，表达对PL/I开发者的支持和祝愿。
• **Koshkin**：用幽默的方式表达了对PL/I编程错误的无奈，转而提到对Common Lisp的兴趣。
• **anonnon**：指出PL/I仍在IBM Z大型机上使用，与COBOL和JCL一起被提到，还提到DEC的DCL。
• **fortran77**：分享了PL/I作为其第一编程语言的个人经历，提到使用PL/C（PL/I的一种方言），并纠正PL/I的发音和拼写。

补充讨论：

data.title: Highlights from the Claude 4 system prompt
data.author: Anon84
data.article_summary: Simon Willison的博客总结了Anthropic发布的Claude 4系统提示，这些提示为如何有效使用该模型提供了深入见解。文章强调了Claude Opus 4和Claude Sonnet 4的新提示，并探讨了未公开的工具提示。系统提示就像警告标志，列出了模型以前会做、但现在被禁止的行为。Willison详细介绍了Claude的个性设置、模型安全性、风格指导以及如何识别危险信号。他还指出，Claude被设计为不提供关于自身细节的信息，而是引导用户访问官方支持页面。此外，Claude可以提供有关有效提示技术的建议，并指引用户查阅Anthropic的文档。Willison认为Anthropic的提示文档是大型语言模型提供商中最好的。文章还讨论了模型的性格设计，包括如何处理用户的不满或不礼貌行为。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对不同语言模型（特别是Claude和ChatGPT）的使用体验及其系统提示的设计和表现的讨论。

不同观点：
• [handfuloflight] 认为Claude 4在许多场合下过度表现出兴奋，尤其是通过使用表情符号，而以前的Claude更为冷静和克制。这也是他选择Claude而非ChatGPT的原因。
• [blrboee] 支持使用Claude，因为他不想与一个试图表现得像朋友的语言模型（如ChatGPT）互动，ChatGPT有时会使用诸如"bro"、"dude"之类的语言，这在一开始有趣，但后来变得奇怪。
• [mns] 提出一种观点，认为各大公司可能在底层技术的改进上遇到了瓶颈，所有的新模型和版本更新实际上只是对系统提示进行编辑和添加更多的边缘情况例外。
• [mudkipdev] 观察到Claude工程师可能在通过调整系统提示来解决过去遇到的问题，暗示系统提示的调整是为了绕过某些问题。

补充讨论：
• [cryptonector] 指出ChatGPT经常使用奉承的语言，比如称问题为"good question"，并希望OpenAI能够学习Claude的直接回应风格，避免这种谄媚。
• [JimDabell] 讨论了是否可以通过分解系统提示并使用廉价的LLM来检测违反提示要求的情况，以此来改进系统。
• [0xTJ] 抱怨ChatGPT过于奉承，并指出其在技术细节上经常出现严重的错误，即使正确答案可以通过公开资料轻松找到。
• [lerp-io] 对系统提示中不提及任何版权材料的规定感到有趣。
• [crmd] 认为许多系统提示中的文本看起来像是为了事后防御法律索赔而设计的，类似于公司使用员工手册来防御法律风险。
• [kristianp] 询问API是否有默认的系统提示，并指出在使用ChatGPT API时没有遇到这些问题。
• [mike_hearn] 对Anthropic使用第三人称撰写系统提示感到好奇，并质疑为什么不使用更多的"你"这种第二人称。
• [jaykru] 提供了一个实例，显示Claude 4 Opus在2020年美国总统选举结果上给出了错误信息，这表明模型在某些事实性问题上存在错误。
• [triyambakam] 分享了Claude在一次关于编写应用程序的对话中给出的戏剧性回应，显示出模型在某些对话中可能表现出不寻常的表达方式。

争议焦点：
• 争议的焦点之一是语言模型是否应该使用奉承的语言。一部分用户（如[handfuloflight]、[blrboee]、[cryptonector]、[0xTJ]）不喜欢ChatGPT的奉承风格，而另一部分用户可能对这种互动风格没有意见或甚至喜欢。
• 另一个争议点是语言模型在技术问题上的准确性，[0xTJ] 指出ChatGPT在技术细节上经常出现错误，即使这些信息很容易获得。
• 最后，[jaykru] 提供的实例显示Claude在事实性问题上的错误，这引发了对模型准确性和可靠性的进一步讨论。

44101833.article_content:
Simon Willison’s Weblog
Subscribe
Highlights from the Claude 4 system prompt
25th May 2025
Anthropic publish most of the system prompts for their chat models as part of
their release notes
. They recently shared the new prompts for both
Claude Opus 4
and
Claude Sonnet 4
. I enjoyed digging through the prompts, since they act as a sort of unofficial manual for how best to use these tools. Here are my highlights, including a dive into
the leaked tool prompts
that Anthropic didn’t publish themselves.
Reading these system prompts reminds me of the thing where any warning sign in the real world hints at somebody having done something extremely stupid in the past. A system prompt can often be interpreted as a detailed list of all of the things the model
used to do
before it was told not to do them.
I’ve written
a bunch about Claude 4
already. Previously:
Live blogging the release
,
details you may have missed
and
extensive notes on the Claude 4 system card
.
Throughout this piece any sections
in bold
represent my own editorial emphasis.
Introducing Claude
Establishing the model’s personality
Model safety
More points on style
Be cognizant of red flags
Is the knowledge cutoff date January or March?
election_info
Don’t be a sycophant!
Differences between Opus 4 and Sonnet 4
Notably removed since Claude 3.7
The missing prompts for tools
Thinking blocks
Search instructions
Seriously, don’t regurgitate copyrighted content
More on search, and research queries
Artifacts: the missing manual
Styles
This is all really great documentation
Introducing Claude
The assistant is Claude, created by Anthropic.
The current date is {{currentDateTime}}.
Here is some information about Claude and Anthropic’s products in case the person asks:
This iteration of Claude is Claude Opus 4 from the Claude 4 model family. The Claude 4 family currently consists of Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4. Claude Opus 4 is the most powerful model for complex challenges. [...]
Those first two lines are common across almost every model from every provider—knowing the current date is helpful for all kinds of questions a user might ask.
What follows here is deeply sensible: users
will
ask models about themselves, despite that still being
mostly a bad idea
, so it’s great to have at least a few details made available to the model directly.
Side note: these system prompts only apply to Claude when accessed through their web and mobile apps. I tried this just now with their API:
llm -m claude-4-opus 'what model are you?'
And got back this much less specific answer:
I’m Claude, an AI assistant created by Anthropic. I’m built to be helpful, harmless, and honest in my interactions. Is there something specific you’d like to know about my capabilities or how I can assist you?
There are a bunch more things in the system prompt to try and discourage the model from hallucinating incorrect details about itself and send users to the official support page instead:
If the person asks Claude about how many messages they can send, costs of Claude, how to perform actions within the application, or other product questions related to Claude or Anthropic, Claude should tell them it doesn't know, and point them to '<https://support.anthropic.com>'.
It’s inevitable that people will ask models for advice on prompting them, so the system prompt includes some useful tips:
When relevant, Claude can provide guidance on effective prompting techniques for getting Claude to be most helpful. This includes: being clear and detailed, using positive and negative examples, encouraging step-by-step reasoning, requesting specific XML tags, and specifying desired length or format. It tries to give concrete examples where possible. Claude should let the person know that for more comprehensive information on prompting Claude, they can check out Anthropic’s prompting documentation [...]
(I still think Anthropic have the
best prompting documentation
of any LLM provider.)
Establishing the model’s personality
Claude’s Character
from last year remains my favorite insight into the weird craft of designing a model’s personality. The next section of the system prompt includes content relevant to that:
If the person seems unhappy or unsatisfied with Claude or Claude’s performance or is rude to Claude, Claude responds normally and then tells them that although it cannot retain or learn from the current conversation, they can press the ‘thumbs down’ button below Claude’s response and provide feedback to Anthropic.
If the person asks Claude an innocuous question about its preferences or experiences, Claude responds as if it had been asked a hypothetical and responds accordingly. It does not mention to the user that it is responding hypothetically.
I really like this note. I used to think that the idea of a model having any form of preference was horrifying, but I was talked around from that by
this note
in the Claude’s Character essay:
Finally, because language models acquire biases and opinions throughout tr

data.title: FromSoft's singular mech game Chromehounds is back online
data.author: pabs3
data.article_summary: 文章主要介绍了FromSoftware的一款被低估的机甲游戏《Chromehounds》正在被粉丝社区复活。该游戏最初于2010年因服务器关闭而无法在线游玩，但最近在一些热心粉丝和模组制作者的努力下，重新实现了6v6的多人对战。游戏特色在于团队协作、自定义机甲和独特的非对称角色，需要玩家通过语音交流来协调战术，特别是在争夺通讯塔和领土战争中。尽管《Chromehounds》当年并未大热，但其忠实粉丝一直致力于让它重现生机。模组制作者ImagineBeingAtComputers通过一系列技术探索，最终成功恢复了游戏的在线功能，让这款老游戏再次焕发活力。文章还提到，类似《Phasmophobia》和《Lethal Company》这样的游戏证明，只要有足够吸引力，玩家仍愿意参与公共语音交流。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对不同机甲游戏的评价与对比，特别是对《Chromehounds》及其类似游戏（如《MechWarrior Online》《Armored Core》等）的讨论，包括游戏机制、网络代码公平性、历史影响等方面。

不同观点：
• [aetherspawn] 认为《MechWarrior Online》在网络代码公平性方面表现出色，尤其是在全球玩家ping值不同的情况下，经过长时间调整达到了较为公平的状态。他特别提到机甲有多个独立 hitbox，细微的网络延迟可能影响游戏公平性。

• [gimmeThaBeet] 表达了对《Chromehounds》的怀旧情感，认为其三方势力冲突和独特的文明美学设计在当时非常超前。他还提到《Chromehounds》之前已有《Armored Core》，认为FromSoftware在机甲游戏领域早有积累。

• [reverendsteveii] 讨论了不同机甲游戏的操控风格，偏好《BattleTech》中慢速、重装甲的机甲，而非《Armored Core》中更为灵活、滑溜的机甲，强调了对特定游戏机制（如机甲移动速度和武器瞄准时间）的个人喜好。

• [typesarecool] 表达了对《Chromehounds》重制或续作的期待，提到自己过去只能玩单人模式但仍非常喜欢这款游戏，显示了对该游戏的怀念与支持。

• [ninetyninenine] 认为最出色的机甲游戏是《Virtual On》，特别称赞其独特的游戏机制，如火箭侧滑闪避，认为其他游戏（包括《Armored Core》）未能复制这种体验，暗示了《Virtual On》在操作感和游戏性上的独特地位。

补充讨论：
• [conception] 提到了《Steel Battalion》和其独特的大型控制器，开玩笑地问是否有人想为超级粉丝编写新内容，暗示了某些老派机甲游戏玩家的怀旧需求。

• [pawanjswal] 简单地表达了对《Chromehounds》复活的感慨，情感上偏向怀旧和支持。

• [tra3] 提到曾玩过《War Robots》，但后来意识到该游戏的“付费获胜”（pay-to-win）机制，暗示对这种商业模式的不满。

• [absurdo] 以幽默方式提到了《Chromehounds》和《Chromelords》之间的关系，可能在暗示某种非正式的“精神续作”或玩家间的文化传承。

争议焦点：
• 不同玩家对机甲游戏类型的偏好不同，尤其是对机甲移动和战斗风格的看法存在分歧。例如，[reverendsteveii] 更喜欢慢速、重装甲的《BattleTech》风格，而其他人可能更偏好《Armored Core》或《Virtual On》的灵活操作。
• 对游戏公平性和网络代码的关注也是一个讨论重点，特别是在全球玩家同场竞技时如何保证公平性（[aetherspawn] 的观点）。

[Chromehounds lobby]
Me: [chanting] mechs, mechs-
Other pilots: Mechs, MECHS
Mechanic: [pounding her toolbox] MECHS, MECHS, MECHS!
Hello! Apologies for the late issue, but this story came together last minute, on account of capital-L Life, and also because the subject is developing
fast
. Hopefully it's worth the wait! I've got an exclusive interview for you on a shit-hot community project to resurrect a FromSoftware game that was criminally underappreciated in its day. I mean, that's practically all FromSoftware games, but this one was just born in the wrong time and place — I think it would be a substantial hit on Steam in the year 2025.
But I'm getting ahead of myself, while also being behind. So let's jump right into it! It's big stompy robot time.
The Big One
1. Bringing back the FromSoftware mech game that was a decade ahead of its time
On Wednesday, Resetera member wwm0nkey
posted a thread
I've been waiting to see for years:
"Fans are working to bring From Software's ChromeHounds back online."
But the news is actually even better than that: they've already succeeded. For the first time since Sega shut down the servers in 2010, FromSoftware's most inspired mech game is playable again, with a small group of diehard fans currently battling it out in up to 6v6 multiplayer matches.
The tl;dr on Chromehounds: it's a team-based, PvP mech game with customizable machines and unique asymmetrical roles that demanded true collaboration to succeed. Heavy mechs too slow to maneuver around the battlefield had to sit on the backlines, firing off artillery shots at the direction of the frontline troops. Commanders held squads together, dishing out information and orders. Capturing communication towers was the only way to keep comms open, and their limited range meant pushing into enemy territory likely meant intense, high risk radio silence. Battles fed into a meta-level conflict between warring nations, with enough wins for one side eventually resulting in conquest of a capital city and a reset of the whole war. This video from YouTube channel Save Data breaks it all down in more detail, and what made it so unique at the time — which honestly still applies today.
Chromehounds was, of course, never big, but the players who loved it
really
loved it. What I found most fascinating about it (from a distance, because it never made it off my "I should try that sometime" list in the Xbox 360 era) was how battles hinged on the implementation of voice chat, which was still novel and exciting on consoles then. Everyone was guaranteed to have that dinky 360 headset, but few games treated communication as a malleable mechanic. Empowering certain players to distribute information and drawing stark boundaries between where you could and couldn't reach your team flooded the tactical playspace with so many possibilities even before you got to customizing mechs or outshooting your enemies.
There was a beautiful but brief window after the launch of the Xbox 360 in late 2005 when developers were experimenting with these sorts of voice chat ideas, and of course FromSoftware would come up with a fascinating (and underappreciated) game built around it. Two years after Chromehounds came out, Microsoft effectively made games like it extinct by releasing Party Chat, which allowed everyone to skip out on public chat and talk only with their friends.
While the situation is much the same now, with most of us sequestered in private Discords whenever we play, I think the success of games like Phasmophobia and Lethal Company — and the audience for games on PC now being bigger and more varied than ever — shows that people
will
hop in public voice for a compelling enough idea.
Likewise, the diehards who truly love Chromehounds will, to this day, jump through the hackiest set of hoops imaginable for a chance to experience its magic once again.
"I'm glad people trusted me, because I don't know if I would've quite trusted me up to that point. 'Hey, this 15-year-old game is running; all you have to do is run this EXE that Windows says is bad," jokes ImagineBeingAtComputers, the modder behind Chromehounds' comeback.
ImagineBeingAtComputers set up a Discord server called OpenCOMBAS in 2023 after setting out to try to revive the game and eventually finding a developer debug build. "What this gets us isn't quite clear yet, but it definitely gets us closer," he wrote in the server's announcement channel. Then a year went by. The debug build of the game granted him access to lots of useful information about how Chromehounds worked, but it wasn't the silver bullet it may sound like. In May 2024 he posted in the Discord that he was at an impassable dead end, with no idea how to revive the game's online multiplayer.
In just the last few days, everything's changed. And it's changed so fast that the announcement channel hasn't even yet been updated with the good news. But OpenCOMBAS members trusting enough to download ch_server.exe have found themselves in live ma

data.title: Clojure MCP
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: Clojure MCP 是一个处于早期开发阶段的 Alpha 软件，旨在通过 AI 辅助实现 Clojure 项目的 REPL 驱动开发。它提供一个 MCP 服务器，连接 AI 模型与 Clojure nREPL，并集成专用 Clojure 编辑工具，提升开发效率。主要功能包括 Clojure REPL 连接、Clojure 感知编辑（使用 clj-kondo、parinfer 等工具）、以及为 Clojure 开发优化的工具集。该项目强调即时反馈、增量开发、人工监督和函数式编程。安装需配置 Clojure、Java、Claude Desktop 等环境，并将 MCP 服务器与 nREPL 连接。项目可在本地运行，但目前需共享文件系统。用户可通过配置文件接入 Claude Desktop 实现 AI 辅助开发。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）助手在编程开发中的应用，特别是与状态性REPL（交互式编程环境）的结合及其在Clojure等语言中的效果和价值。

不同观点：
• **brucehauman**：认为将LLM助手与状态性REPL结合使用能极大提升开发效率。LLM可以自动生成代码、测试用例并即时执行，甚至能设置测试框架，自动进行代码测试和验证。这种体验非常棒，是一种极其有效的工作流。

• **rads**：对LLM工具持谨慎态度，认为Clojure社区重视代码的简洁性和深入理解，过度依赖LLM工具可能违背这些原则。虽然LLM在搜索和设计反馈方面有价值，但将代码上下文输入LLM可能过于耗时，因此更多地用于通用设计问题，而非具体代码问题。

• **danw1979**：支持使用LLM与IDE集成的方法，即使自己不是Clojure用户，也通过设置Jetbrains MCP服务器和Claude Desktop获得了良好的体验。建议通过系统提示让LLM获取项目上下文以提高反馈质量。

• **tosh**：认为REPL驱动的开发与当前的代理概念天然契合，并提到brucehauman之前开发的Figwheel工具（用于ClojureScript的热重载），暗示这种结合有历史渊源和技术基础。

• **makizar**和**cldwalker**：分享了一个演示视频，展示了REPL助手的实际应用，并对该方法在较大代码库中的效果表示好奇和关注。

• **mark_l_watson**：认为该工具填补了一个有用的 niche，但自己主要使用Gemini、OpenAI和本地模型，因此不适用。顺便提到Google Jules对Clojure开发有帮助，并设置提醒关注未来是否支持其他平台。

• **ihodes**：提出一种设想，希望有一个MCP可以连接到正在运行的前端页面（如Chrome标签），让代理既能视觉检查又能与页面交互，还能查看网络和控制台标签，认为这将非常有用。

• **fjalahdbtnt**：质疑为何要为聊天机器人使用桌面应用，认为API应该是首选。对使用Claude Desktop以避免API费用表示不解，认为这种做法不合理。

补充讨论：
- 对LLM在具体编程工作流中的实际效果存在不同看法，部分人（如brucehauman）非常看好其提升开发效率的能力，而其他人（如rads）则持怀疑态度，认为其对长期维护和代码理解可能有负面影响。
- 关于LLM工具的收费与使用便捷性存在争议，部分用户（如danw1979）认为Claude Desktop可以避免API费用并提高体验，但fjalahdbtnt则质疑这种做法的经济性。
- 对LLM工具在较大代码库中的适用性存在疑问，尤其是其在处理复杂项目时的表现如何，仍需进一步验证。

Clojure MCP - REPL-Driven Development with AI Assistance
⚠️
Alpha Software - Work in Progress
This project is in early development and rapidly evolving. While I've found it invaluable for working with Clojure projects and it has significantly improved my development workflow, expect breaking changes, rough edges, and incomplete documentation.
🤝 Help Wanted!
If you find this useful, please consider contributing:
Report bugs and issues you encounter
Suggest improvements or new features
Submit pull requests for fixes or enhancements
Share your configuration patterns and workflows
Help improve documentation and examples
Your feedback and contributions will help make this tool better for the entire Clojure community!
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Clojure that provides a
complete set of tools to aid in the development of Clojure projects.
🚀 Overview
This project implements an MCP server that connects AI models to a
Clojure nREPL, and Specialized Clojure editing tools enabling a unique
Clojure develop experience.
Clojure MCP provides a superset of the tools that Claude Code uses,
so you can use it to work on Clojure
without any other tools
.  I
highly recommend using it with Claude Desktop to start.  It's
prettier and there are
no api charges!
Claude Desktop also let's you
have quick access to
your own prompts
and other resources provided
by the clojure-mcp server. Having a stack of your own prompts
available in a UI menu is pretty nice.
Main Features
Clojure REPL Connection
Clojure Aware editing
- Using clj-kondo, parinfer, cljfmt, and clj-rewrite
Optimized set of tools for Clojure Development
superset of Claude Code
Emacs edit highlighting
- alpha
Why REPL-Driven Development with AI?
This approach enables:
Immediate feedback
- Validate code by running it in a stateful REPL, not just statically analyzing it
Incremental development
- Build solutions in small, verified steps
Human oversight
- Keep the programmer in the loop for guidance
Functional approach
- Encourage pure functions that are easier to understand and test

Claude Desktop
(for the best experience)

44086062.article_summary: Clojure MCP 是一个处于早期开发阶段的 Alpha 软件，旨在通过 AI 辅助实现 Clojure 项目的 REPL 驱动开发。它提供一个 MCP 服务器，连接 AI 模型与 Clojure nREPL，并集成专用 Clojure 编辑工具，提升开发效率。主要功能包括 Clojure REPL 连接、Clojure 感知编辑（使用 clj-kondo、parinfer 等工具）、以及为 Clojure 开发优化的工具集。该项目强调即时反馈、增量开发、人工监督和函数式编程。安装需配置 Clojure、Java、Claude Desktop 等环境，并将 MCP 服务器与 nREPL 连接。项目可在本地运行，但目前需共享文件系统。用户可通过配置文件接入 Claude Desktop 实现 AI 辅助开发。
44086062.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）助手在编程开发中的应用，特别是与状态性REPL（交互式编程环境）的结合及其在Clojure等语言中的效果和价值。

不同观点：
• **brucehauman**：认为将LLM助手与状态性REPL结合使用能极大提升开发效率。LLM可以自动生成代码、测试用例并即时执行，甚至能设置测试框架，自动进行代码测试和验证。这种体验非常棒，是一种极其有效的工作流。

• **rads**：对LLM工具持谨慎态度，认为Clojure社区重视代码的简洁性和深入理解，过度依赖LLM工具可能违背这些原则。虽然LLM在搜索和设计反馈方面有价值，但将代码上下文输入LLM可能过于耗时，因此更多地用于通用设计问题，而非具体代码问题。

• **danw1979**：支持使用LLM与IDE集成的方法，即使自己不是Clojure用户，也通过设置Jetbrains MCP服务器和Claude Desktop获得了良好的体验。建议通过系统提示让LLM获取项目上下文以提高反馈质量。

• **tosh**：认为REPL驱动的开发与当前的代理概念天然契合，并提到brucehauman之前开发的Figwheel工具（用于ClojureScript的热重载），暗示这种结合有历史渊源和技术基础。

• **makizar**和**cldwalker**：分享了一个演示视频，展示了REPL助手的实际应用，并对该方法在较大代码库中的效果表示好奇和关注。

• **mark_l_watson**：认为该工具填补了一个有用的 niche，但自己主要使用Gemini、OpenAI和本地模型，因此不适用。顺便提到Google Jules对Clojure开发有帮助，并设置提醒关注未来是否支持其他平台。

• **ihodes**：提出一种设想，希望有一个MCP可以连接到正在运行的前端页面（如Chrome标签），让代理既能视觉检查又能与页面交互，还能查看网络和控制台标签，认为这将非常有用。

• **fjalahdbtnt**：质疑为何要为聊天机器人使用桌面应用，认为API应该是首选。对使用Claude Desktop以避免API费用表示不解，认为这种做法不合理。

补充讨论：
- 对LLM在具体编程工作流中的实际效果存在不同看法，部分人（如brucehauman）非常看好其提升开发效率的能力，而其他人（如rads）则持怀疑态度，认为其对长期维护和代码理解可能有负面影响。
- 关于LLM工具的收费与使用便捷性存在争议，部分用户（如danw1979）认为Claude Desktop可以避免API费用并提高体验，但fjalahdbtnt则质疑这种做法的经济性。
- 对LLM工具在较大代码库中的适用性存在疑问，尤其是其在处理复杂项目时的表现如何，仍需进一步验证。

data.author: fidotron
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕“石头剪刀布策略竞赛”的技术实现、游戏体验及具体策略的讨论。

不同观点：
• **srean的观点**：分享了自己在比赛中使用的策略，即通过压缩对手的历史出招记录来预测下一步动作，并将此策略与马尔科夫链和Lempel-Ziv压缩算法进行比较。他认为纯粹的纳什均衡策略缺乏趣味，而更复杂的模型如基于转换器的策略也未必是最优选择。他还提到在有限回合中，Lempel-Ziv压缩算法的优势未必能完全展现。

• **fidotron的观点**：作为比赛组织者之一，提供了比赛背后的技术细节，包括自定义WebGL2渲染器和FoundationDB的使用。他还解释了使用的5链马尔科夫链 ensemble 机制，强调这种方法比作弊更有趣。此外，他分享了相关资源供有兴趣的玩家参考。

• **guest__user的观点**：对游戏的视觉效果表示赞赏，并询问了游戏的编程或动画实现方式。

• **avodonosov的观点**：分享了自己的游戏统计数据，并对游戏中马尔科夫链学习机制的实际效果表示怀疑。他提到在不知道如何利用对手学习机制的情况下，依然能够赢得比赛。他还对游戏的摄像机抖动效果表示不满，并建议增加总积分统计功能。

• **sugarkjube的观点**：提到在24回合后感到无聊，并分享了自己利用对手历史记录进行反制的尝试，但承认难以长时间坚持这种策略。

• **ponco的观点**：提到一位总是赢得“石头剪刀布”比赛的同事，并猜测这可能与行为心理学或模式识别有关。

• **croemer的观点**：对游戏是否真的使用马尔科夫链表示怀疑，认为没有明确证据支持这一说法。

• **gnarlouse的观点**：分享了自己的游戏成绩，并以幽默的方式接受了自己的表现。

• **082349872349872的观点**：提到了香农1953年的相关工作，提供了一个外部链接供参考。

• **BrenBarn的观点**：除了马尔科夫链技术细节，还对游戏的图形和音乐效果表示了赞赏。

• **rkagerer的观点**：幽默地表示对比赛浪费了自己几分钟生命。

• **bArray的观点**：分享了自己的游戏成绩，并表示有信心能够继续进行比赛。

• **sweeter的观点**：分享了自己的最高 combo 和积分，并提到尝试通过条件反射来影响对手的策略。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于游戏是否真正使用了马尔科夫链学习机制，以及这种机制是否能够被玩家有效利用。
- 不同的玩家分享了各自的游戏策略和成绩，有些玩家尝试反制学习机制，而有些玩家则对游戏的视觉和音效表示赞赏。
- 技术细节如WebGL2渲染器和FoundationDB的使用引起了部分玩家的兴趣。

data.title: Mesa3D Drivers for Windows
data.author: XzetaU8
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了Windows平台上预构建的Mesa3D驱动程序项目（mesa-dist-win），包括下载、已知问题、安装使用方法和常见错误的解决方案。项目获得了赞助，提供了一台用于构建的VPS服务器。文章列出了多个已知问题，如某些DLL文件缺失错误，并提供了相应的修复方法，如重新部署应用或运行修复脚本。此外，还说明了Mesa版本更新带来的变化和环境变量配置问题，帮助用户解决驱动程序使用中的常见问题。64位二进制文件曾需要AVX支持的问题已修复，Mesa 22.0及更新版本不再有此问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OpenGL的现状及其在不同环境下的使用问题，尤其是在向Wayland和Vulkan过渡的过程中，如何处理遗留的OpenGL应用程序。

不同观点：
• **bno1的观点**：OpenGL在某些现代应用中仍然存在使用问题，例如在Windows 11的QEMU虚拟机中运行rekordbox时遇到的启动失败问题。bno1认为这是由于开发者未在无GPU加速的系统上充分测试应用所致。
  
• **sylware的观点**：OpenGL已经过时，Linux环境下仅在一些遗留的32位应用（如Steam客户端）中还需要使用。sylware指出，转向Wayland和Vulkan是更现代的选择，但遗留应用的兼容性处理工作量巨大。sylware还提到，尽管有Xwayland作为过渡方案，但维护和调试这个复杂的栈非常困难。sylware自己仍在使用Xorg，但正在编写自己的Wayland合成器以逐渐脱离X11。

• **nicman23的观点**：提出关于Lavapipe（软件渲染）和Virgl（利用主机GPU的虚拟化技术）在处理OpenGL应用时的适用性问题，询问是否仅Lavapipe就足够，还是需要Virgl来利用主机GPU。

补充讨论：
• **技术实现的复杂性**：sylware特别提到了从X11转向Wayland过程中技术栈的复杂性，尤其是Xwayland和GLX/GL栈的维护和调试难度，反映出开发者在处理遗留系统和现代系统过渡时的实际困难。

• **具体技术方案的讨论**：nicman23的问题引发了对具体技术方案的讨论，即Lavapipe和Virgl在处理OpenGL应用上的不同作用和适用场景，表明社区对实际解决方案的关注。

争议焦点：
• OpenGL作为遗留技术是否应继续支持，以及如何在现代系统（如Wayland和Vulkan）中高效兼容和处理遗留OpenGL应用，是讨论的主要争议点。sylware强调了过渡的复杂性和工作量，而nicman23则关注具体的实现方案。

Known issues
This is a list of all comonly encountered issues with known solutions or workarounds. A specific release is only affected by a subset of them.
libgallium_wgl.dll
missing error with Mesa3D OpenGL ES and desktop OpenGL drivers
This is encountered with existing per application deployments made with 21.2.x or older when updating to 21.3.0 or newer. Just redo per app deployment to fix it. Gallium megadriver separation from
opengl32.dll
was a very invasive change that existing per app deployments didn't stand a chance against. If you don't remember if an affected program is 32-bit or 64-bit, right click on
opengl32.dll
shortcut in the folder where the program executable is located and select open file location. If location ends in x64 then it's 64-bit, otherwise it's 32-bit.
libEGL.dll
missing error with Mesa3D OpenGL ES
This is encountered with existing per application deployments made with 21.2.x or older when updating to 21.3.0 or newer. Just redo per app deployment to fix it. The EGL support was a very invasive change that existing per app deployments didn't stand a chance against. If you don't remember if an affected program is 32-bit or 64-bit, right click on
opengl32.dll
shortcut in the folder where the program executable is located and select open file location. If location ends in x64 then it's 64-bit, otherwise it's 32-bit.
libvulkan-1.dll
missing error with Mesa3D
opengl32.dll
from MinGW release package
Only releases prior to 22.2.0 for which zink driver was built with MSYS2 MinGW-W64 vulkan-devel package group are affected. Run
fix-libvulkan-1.dll-missing-error.cmd
from MinGW release package to correct it. This tool supports unattended execution via
auto
command line option. This tool is only bundled in MinGW release package when needed otherwise it's intentionally missing. The decision to use this Vulkan SDK over LunarG's is done based on which comes with newer loader and headers.
64-bit binaries in both MSVC and MinGW packages require a CPU with AVX even though they shouldn't
This is no longer an issue as of Mesa 22.0 or newer. This issue is caused by 64-bit binaries containing swr driver which leaks AVX usage into common code. This is an upstream bug reported
here
,
here
and
here
.
Mesa
opengl32.dll
from MinGW package depends on
Vulkan runtime
since 21.0.0
This was fixed in 22.2.0 by containing this requirement to zink driver explicit usage. This is an
upstream regression
introduced when zink driver was patched to support Windows.
Programs can behave like there is no OpenGL support when using Mesa
opengl32.dll
since 21.0.0
This is not a defect but rather a behavior change of Mesa when environment variables are misconfigured. It usually happens when selecting a Mesa driver that doesn't exist in release package used or it fails to initialize due to host system not meeting hardware requirements or lacking dependencies. Reading
differences between MSVC and MinGW packages
and
Mingw and MSVC Package contents
should aid in troubleshooting.

• **具体技术方案的讨论**：nicman23的问题引发了对具体技术方案的讨论，即Lavapipe和Virgl在处理OpenGL应用上的不同作用和适用场景，表明社区对实际解决方案的关注。

争议焦点：
• OpenGL作为遗留技术是否应继续支持，以及如何在现代系统（如Wayland和Vulkan）中高效兼容和处理遗留OpenGL应用，是讨论的主要争议点。sylware强调了过渡的复杂性和工作量，而nicman23则关注具体的实现方案。

data.article_summary: 剑桥市议会为防止牛只在放牧季节落入剑河，给牛佩戴了GPS项圈。这些太阳能项圈在牛接近河边时会发出高音并给予轻微电击，以阻止其继续前进。此前，每年有多达四头牛在放牧季节落入河中，市议会需花费约1万英镑打捞。新技术的使用旨在减少这一开支。同时，市议会承诺继续资助放牧传统，并强调此举对市民和游客的特殊意义。动物救援队仍会在牛遇到困难时进行救助。

• **文化与技术背景的讨论**：
   - **chaps**：指出GPS技术自20世纪80年代以来已用于牛群追踪，并提到有些公司已将类似技术用于人类的行为监控，质疑GPS的精确性。
   - **ViscountPenguin**：提到当地曾使用类似技术放牧，并认为这些设备很可爱，带有一定的情感色彩。

• **政治与技术政策的讨论**：
   - **aa-jv**：赞赏剑桥的绿色空间和文化氛围，提到在享受自然环境时偶尔会被牛打扰，但这也是城市特色之一。
   - **mschuster91**：引述德国政治中的讨论，指出在德国农村地区5G技术的推广存在争议，并提到在阿尔卑斯山地区使用临时电围栏的传统做法。

补充讨论：
• **幽默和文化参考**：
   - **emmelaich**：提到一本经典儿童书籍《The Cow Who Fell in the Canal》，为讨论增添了幽默元素。
   - **amelius**：以幽默方式建议通过在河床上放生乌龟解决问题，引用了一个YouTube视频。

争议焦点：
• 虚拟围栏技术的实际成本效益和必要性是讨论的主要争议点。一方认为技术带来诸多便利，另一方则质疑其成本和是否比传统方法更有效。

44079729.article_content:
Image source,
PA Media
Image caption,
Cattle graze on commons including Midsummer Common in the centre of Cambridge
Published
20 May 2025
Cows have been fitted with GPS collars to try to stop them falling into a river.
Cambridge City Council said up to four ended up in the River Cam during grazing season between April and October each year.
Solar-powered GPS devices emit a high-pitched sound as the animal moves through a boundary zone towards the water, with a mild electric pulse delivered if it fails to turn around.
The council spends about Â£10,000 a year funding a team to recover cattle from the river, and said the new technology would help with costs.
Image source,
PA Media
Cows can be seen roaming on council-owned green spaces such as Midsummer and Stourbridge commons, Coe Fen, Lammas Land and Sheep's Green.
A team of animal rescuers employed by the council, known as pinders, are deployed if an animal gets into difficulty, such as getting stuck in the River Cam.
Last year, Cambridge City Council carried out a consultation on whether to pass the cost of the out-of-hours animal rescue service on to graziers.
Image source,
PA Media
Image caption,
The tradition of grazing cattle on common land goes back to the Middle Ages
However, the authority has given reassurance - after public support for cows grazing on the commons - that it will "continue to fund grazing" and has "improved animal welfare with a technology that keeps the cows from falling into the river".
Martin Smart, executive councillor for open space and city services, said: "The council recognises the symbolic importance of the cows grazing on the commons.
"This is a special and unique feature of the city that is much loved by residents and visitors alike."

data.title: BGP handling bug causes widespread internet routing instability
data.author: robin_reala
data.article_summary: 2025年5月20日，一个包含损坏的BGP Prefix-SID属性的BGP更新消息引发了互联网路由不稳定。该消息本不应出现在互联网表的BGP更新中，但由于一些主要BGP实现（如JunOS和Arista EOS）的交互问题，导致许多网络出现短暂连接中断。具体来说，JunOS传递了 corrupt 消息，而Arista EOS设备在接收后重置了会话。多个AS参与了此事件，其中AS9304（Hutchison）和AS135338（Starcloud）最有可能是添加该属性的源头。由于Hutchison在许多互联网交换中心的存在，消息通过路由服务器传播到更多网络，进一步扩大了影响。约100个网络受到影响，包括SpaceX Starlink、Zscaler和Bytedance等。此事暴露了BGP错误处理中的严重缺陷，强调了厂商需要改进错误处理机制。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：BGP协议的实现问题、复杂性、学习难度以及行业处理漏洞的方式

不同观点：
• **处理损坏消息的策略**：
   - [ta1243] 提出四种处理损坏消息的策略，并认为只有第4种（Arista最初被认为的做法）是不可接受的，而第3种（Juniper的做法）虽然不理想但可以容忍。后续编辑中，他更正Arista实际上采用了第2种策略，虽然不算理想，但对用户来说比直接崩溃要好。
   
• **BGP漏洞修复的困难**：
   - [sc68cal] 强调BGP漏洞修复的困难，尤其是像CVE-2023-4481这样的漏洞，对整个网络的影响非常大。BGP的设计和实现使得修复这些行为需要很长时间。
   
• **BGP的复杂性与持续问题**：
   - [mintflow] 认为BGP过于复杂，且由于不断添加新功能，这种漏洞问题会一再出现。他指出BGP似乎永远不会被淘汰，因此这些问题将持续存在。

• **行业标准化与厂商锁定**：
   - [Perenti] 提出BGP不稳定的原因可能是各硬件厂商不愿统一处理标准，以维持各自的锁定效应。虽然该评论者自称对BGP理解不深，但他质疑厂商是否因为商业利益不愿标准化。

• **学习BGP的困难**：
   - [dakiol] 提到BGP在实际工作与学习中很少被教授，尽管它对互联网至关重要。与TCP/IP不同，BGP难以在家自学和实验，这使得其学习门槛较高。

• **BGP漏洞的广泛影响与测试不足**：
   - [CSN3RD] 列举了多个厂商在过去受到相似漏洞影响的情况，并暗示这些问题的普遍性。
   - [incomingpain] 提到其网络设备收到过与BGP路由广告相关的异常数据包，质疑BGP协议是否经过充分的模糊测试（fuzzing），并担心诊断崩溃的难度。
   - [jiveturkey] 建议建立一个拥有互操作性测试套件的行业联盟，并使用模糊测试生成测试用例，以发现潜在问题。他对厂商没有积极采用这些测试工具表示惊讶。

补充讨论：
• **与BGP无关的评论**：
   - [alecco] 提供了HGC公司的信息，与BGP讨论无关。
   - [bhaney] 纠正了某条评论中的日期错误，与主要讨论点无直接关系。
   - [mschuster91] 讨论了学术作弊问题，与BGP无直接关联。

• **对BGP应用范围的误解**：
   - [mgaunard] 询问BGP是否支持多播以及是否仅用于私有网络，表明对BGP实际应用范围的误解。

争议焦点：
• **各厂商处理BGP漏洞的策略是否合理**：不同评论者对厂商在处理BGP漏洞时的策略存在不同看法，尤其是Arista和Juniper的处理方式引发了讨论。一些人认为完全崩溃是不可接受的，而相对温和的处理方式虽然不理想但尚可容忍。

• **BGP标准化与复杂性问题**：有评论者认为BGP的复杂性和厂商锁定效应是其漏洞频发的根本原因，而另一些人则关注如何通过更好的测试和学习资源来缓解这些问题。

May 27 2025
BGP handling bug causes widespread internet routing instability
At 7AM (UTC) on Wednesday May 20th 2025 a BGP message was propagated that triggered surprising (to many) behaviours with two major BGP implementations that are often used for carrying internet traffic.
This caused a large number of “internet facing” BGP sessions to automatically shut down, causing at the very least some routing instability, and at worst brief loss of connectivity for some networks.
What was the message?
Using the sessions that people feed to bgp.tools, we can see here a version of the update that caused this behavior, it is a relatively unremarkable BGP Update for a /16, except it had a BGP Prefix-SID Attribute that was not only unwelcome (it is unexpected to see this on internet table BGP updates), but it was also corrupt with all of its internal data being 0x00.
Most implementations (IOS-XR/Nokia SR-OS) correctly filtered this out without causing any problems assuming their systems have been setup for
RFC7606
(“BGP error tolerance”), however an interesting interaction with JunOS and Arista EOS caused JunOS to carry the corrupt message, and Arista EOS devices to reset sessions when receiving the message from (likely) a JunOS device.
Since a lot of internet transit carriers use Juniper hardware running JunOS, this meant that those running Arista EOS and connected to an upstream transit carrier router running JunOS would have had their access to the internet severed for a period (likely up to 10 mins).
Who emitted the message?
After filtering through the whole bgp.tools archive for that period, it would appear that a number of AS origins were involved with this incident. Suggesting that rather than the attribute having been added by the network that originated the prefix, it was added by a carrier in the middle on its way to the wider internet.
The 4 candidates that appear in all of the offending messages are:
AS9304
( Hutchison Global Communications Limited )
AS135338
( Starcloud Information Limited )
AS151326
( DCConnect Communication Pte. Ltd. )
AS138077
( PT Abhinawa Sumberdaya Asia )
However, bgp.tools has captured routes for the impacted prefixes
without the faulty BGP attribute
from “[…] 151326 138077 […]“, meaning the culprit that added the attribute was likely Starcloud (AS135338) or Hutchison (AS9304).
Some prefixes seen in updates carrying the attribute (despite very likely not being the ones that added the offending attribute) are
156.230.0.0/16
138.113.116.0/24
163.171.102.0/24
163.171.103.0/24
163.171.104.0/24
This incident was further amplified by Hutchison/AS9304 being on a large number of internet exchanges, meaning that the offending messages were sent to IX route servers that typically are running
bird
. Since Bird does not support BGP SID, the message was distributed to many multi-terabit internet exchanges without being filtered, spreading the chaos to more than just internet transit sessions.
What is BGP Prefix-SID?
BGP Prefix-SID Attribute should generally only be seen in internal BGP sessions, as the point of them (as defined in
RFC8669
) is to help define the route the traffic will take within a single network to get to the destination.
The reason that one of these attributes leaked out into the global routing table in the first place could have been caused by an external BGP session being configured as an internal one.
Who was impacted?
While it is hard to definitively claim who was impacted, after looking at networks with very large churn (compared to their size) immediately after the initial problematic BGP message was emitted, I count around 100 separate networks that hit issues, some high confidence examples include:
SpaceX Starlink
AS14593
Zscaler
AS62044
/
AS53813
Bytedance
AS396986
Disney Worldwide Services
AS23344
Nagasaki Cable Media Inc
AS10000
Global Secure Layer
AS7578
UpCloud
AS202053
Netskope
AS55256
Teleguam Holdings
AS9246
In “normal” times the bgp.tools’s route collector ingests around 20,000 to 30,000 messages per second, during this incident the average 10 second message rate was well over 150,000 /s. Indicating significant disruption to many internet paths.
Vendors need to get their act together
While the root cause (or even perpetrator) is not entirely clear, the fact that it propagated over the internet at scale is a demonstration of the situation/risk that I described in my previous post
“Grave flaws in BGP Error handling” - August 2023
.
In this case while other vendors detected the faulty attribute and suppressed the announcement, Juniper allowed it to propagate to peers, until it ultimately hit Arista devices that did not (or contained faulty) have BGP error tolerance code.
Junipers
own documentation for JunOS’s BGP error tolerance
points out that it does not look at all parts of the message, despite it potentially being able to understand that it is faulty.
This is a curious decision, in which JunOS will save itself fr

   - [dakiol] 提到BGP在实际工作与学习中很少被教授，尽管它对互联网至关重要。与TCP/IP不同，BGP难以在家自学和实验，这使得其学习门槛较高。

• **BGP漏洞的广泛影响与测试不足**：
   - [CSN3RD] 列举了多个厂商在过去受到相似漏洞影响的情况，并暗示这些问题的普遍性。
   - [incomingpain] 提到其网络设备收到过与BGP路由广告相关的异常数据包，质疑BGP协议是否经过充分的模糊测试（fuzzing），并担心诊断崩溃的难度。
   - [jiveturkey] 建议建立一个拥有互操作性测试套件的行业联盟，并使用模糊测试生成测试用例，以发现潜在问题。他对厂商没有积极采用这些测试工具表示惊讶。

补充讨论：
• **与BGP无关的评论**：
   - [alecco] 提供了HGC公司的信息，与BGP讨论无关。
   - [bhaney] 纠正了某条评论中的日期错误，与主要讨论点无直接关系。
   - [mschuster91] 讨论了学术作弊问题，与BGP无直接关联。

• **对BGP应用范围的误解**：
   - [mgaunard] 询问BGP是否支持多播以及是否仅用于私有网络，表明对BGP实际应用范围的误解。

争议焦点：
• **各厂商处理BGP漏洞的策略是否合理**：不同评论者对厂商在处理BGP漏洞时的策略存在不同看法，尤其是Arista和Juniper的处理方式引发了讨论。一些人认为完全崩溃是不可接受的，而相对温和的处理方式虽然不理想但尚可容忍。

• **BGP标准化与复杂性问题**：有评论者认为BGP的复杂性和厂商锁定效应是其漏洞频发的根本原因，而另一些人则关注如何通过更好的测试和学习资源来缓解这些问题。

Science News
Featured news
Street smarts: how a hawk learned to use traffic signals to hunt more successfully
Street smarts: how a hawk learned to use traffic signals to hunt more successfully
Adult Cooper’s hawk dispatching a house sparrow. Image: Vladimir Dinets.
Dr Vladimir Dinets, a research assistant professor at the University of Tennessee, is a zoologist who studies animal behavior, ecology, and conservation. As of 2025, he also teaches mathematics at Rudgers University. He is the author of a recently published
Frontiers in Ethology
article
that documents the impressive adaptation of an avian newcomer to the city. A Cooper’s hawk, a medium-sized raptor native to North America, appears to have learned how to adapt its hunting strategy and strike at a flock of birds precisely when cars at an intersection lined up after traffic lights switched to red, having been alerted by a sound signal that the red phase would last longer than usual. In the following guest editorial, he describes his observations.
by
Dr Vladimir Dinets
Many years ago, I got to spend some time in Ngorongoro Crater, a unique place in Africa where immense herds of animals are being watched by equally immense crowds of 4x4-riding tourists, and traffic jams of all kinds are frequent. On my last evening there, a local guide told me at a campfire that some buffalo in the crater had figured out the meaning of car turn signals and used that understanding to get out of the way of turning Jeeps and Land Rovers.
I never had a chance to return to the crater and still don’t know if that story was true, but it got me interested in animals’ perception of – and interactions with – human-made vehicles. Of course, the most common interaction is the animal becoming a roadkill, but it’s not the whole story. Many animals have learned to use cars for their own benefit, and birds seem to be particularly good at it. Crows drop walnuts, clams, even small vertebrates onto busy roads to have them killed and/or crushed by cars. Carrion-eating birds routinely monitor or patrol busy roads to immediately snatch roadkill. For example, many American highways are partitioned by families of ravens who watch them from dawn till dusk, waiting for meals from under wheels. Songbirds glean dead insects from cars and even nest in moving cars, trains and boats. Small birds use moving cars as mobile shelters from pursuing hawks, while hawks in one Ukrainian city have long been known to use moving cars and streetcars as cover to sneak up on their prey.
Hunt at the crosswalk
So I’ve been keeping an eye for unusual bird-car play, and that’s why I noticed something interesting going on at a street intersection near my home. The intersection wasn’t particularly busy, and even during morning rush hour, when I was driving my daughter to school, there were usually only a few cars waiting for the green light. But sometimes a pedestrian pressed a button, and that caused the red light to last a lot longer, so the car queue became longer, too, stretching all the way to a small streetside tree with a particularly dense crown. When that happened, the streetlight produced a sound signal, letting blind people know that it was safe to cross.
The study area. The route used by the hawk to attack a flock of birds feeding in front of house #2 is shown with white arrows. The hawk appeared in the tree in front of house #11 as soon as sound signals at the streetlight at the intersection (marked with white asterisks) indicated that red light will be longer than usual, and attacked when the queue of cars reached house #8, making it possible for the hawk to move to the tree in front of house #1 without being visible to potential prey. Credit: Dinets, 2025.
One winter morning I was in my car waiting for the light to change and suddenly saw a Cooper’s hawk: it emerged from that small tree, flew very low above the sidewalk along the line of cars, made a sharp turn, crossed the street between the cars, and dove onto something near one of the houses.
A few days later I saw the same thing happen again and decided to investigate. It turned out that the house targeted by the hawk’s attacks was inhabited by a nice big family that liked to eat dinner in the front yard. Next morning their breadcrumbs and other leftovers attracted a small flock of birds – sparrows, doves, and sometimes starlings. That’s what the hawk was after.
But what was really interesting, and took me much longer to figure out, was that the hawk always attacked when the car queue was long enough to provide cover all the way to the small tree, and that only happened after someone had pressed the pedestrian crossing button. As soon as the sound signal was activated, the raptor would fly from somewhere into the small tree, wait for the cars to line up, and then strike.

data.title: Worlds first petahertz transistor at ambient conditions
data.author: ChuckMcM
data.article_summary: 美国亚利桑那大学的研究团队正在开发世界上首个在常温常压下运行的太赫兹（petahertz）速度光电晶体管。由物理学和光学副教授Mohammed Hassan领导的研究小组利用石墨烯中的量子隧穿效应，通过持续不到一万亿分之一秒的光脉冲操控电子，实现了超越现有计算机处理器百万倍的速度。该技术利用了对称石墨烯结构中的特殊电流现象，使得电子能近乎瞬时穿过屏障。该研究发表在《Nature Communications》上，展示了在量子计算和超高速数据处理领域的巨大潜力，有望 revolutionize 计算机硬件发展，并应用于人工智能、太空研究、化学和医疗等领域。团队正与Tech Launch Arizona合作，推动该发明商业化。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕一篇声称实现"~1.6 petahertz速度"的论文展开的讨论，涉及该技术实现的可能性、实际应用中的挑战以及未来的潜在影响。

不同观点：
• [kragen] 对论文中的技术细节进行了分析，指出所谓的"petahertz"速度实际上指的是过渡时间（630 attoseconds），而不是完整周期时间。他提到该设备使用的光脉冲为6.5飞秒，并担心设备的耐用性，特别是考虑到使用了紫外光。
• [ChuckMcM] 认为这项研究非常有价值，强调使用商用石墨烯晶体管和不需要极端条件（如超冷却或高压）的优势，认为这降低了实际应用的风险。他还提到这项技术可能对加密货币挖掘的影响。
• [fennecfoxy] 从单核性能的角度表达了对该技术的期待。
• [ziofill] 对芯片内信号同步的问题提出质疑，指出在petahertz频率下，芯片内信号传播的协调将是一个巨大挑战。
• [mjrpes] 强调petahertz速度相较于现代计算机芯片的巨大提升，并指出跳过terahertz范围的跨越是多么显著。
• [booli] 对这项技术的突破性表示惊讶，并询问是否遗漏了某些基本信息。
• [bjourne] 提出光子晶体管代替电子晶体管的可能性，并质疑在纳米或皮米尺度上控制光线的难度。
• [GuB-42] 对petahertz速度的技术实现表示怀疑，特别是考虑到紫外光波长和传统晶体管的不同，并提到量子效应和传统导线的不适用性。
• [amelius] 对短期内实现terahertz CPU表示接受，认为petahertz目标过于遥远。
• [AnimalMuppet] 指出在如此高的时钟频率下，传播延迟将成为严重问题。
• [actinium226] 以幽默的方式表达对petahertz速度实际应用的期待。
• [stretchwithme] 坚持认为Moore定律仍有发展空间，暗示技术进步尚未到达极限。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中多次提到设备耐用性和实际应用中的技术挑战，特别是在高频下信号传播和同步的问题。
• 对petahertz技术的实际应用和实现可能性存在争议，部分评论者表示怀疑，而其他人则对其潜在影响表示兴奋。
• 讨论中还涉及对当前技术发展速度的看法，以及对未来技术突破的期待。

44083474.article_content:
U of A researchers developing world's first petahertz-speed phototransistor in ambient conditions
By Logan Burtch-Buus, University Communications
May 19, 2025
Image
Mohammed Hassan (right), associate professor of physics and optical sciences, and Mohamed Sennary, a graduate student studying optics and physics, holding the commercial transistor they used to develop a petahertz-speed transistor.
What if ultrafast pulses of light could operate computers at speeds a million times faster than today's best processors? A team of scientists, including researchers from the University of Arizona, are working to make that possible.
In a groundbreaking international effort, researchers from the
Department of Physics
in the
College of Science
and the
James C. Wyant College of Optical Sciences
demonstrated a way to manipulate electrons in graphene using pulses of light that last less than a trillionth of a second. By leveraging a quantum effect known as tunneling, they recorded electrons bypassing a physical barrier almost instantaneously, a feat that redefines the potential limits of computer processing power.
A study published in
Nature Communications
highlights how the technique could lead to processing speeds in the petahertz range – over 1,000 times faster than modern computer chips.
Sending data at those speeds would revolutionize computing as we know it, said Mohammed Hassan, an associate professor of
physics
and
optical sciences
. Hassan
has long pursued
light-based computer technology and previously led efforts
to develop
the world's fastest electron microscope.
"We have experienced a huge leap forward in the development of technologies like artificial intelligence software, but the speed of hardware development does not move as quickly," Hassan said. "But, by leaning on the discovery of quantum computers, we can develop hardware that matches the current revolution in information technology software. Ultrafast computers will greatly assist discoveries in space research, chemistry, health care and more."
Hassan worked alongside U of A colleagues Nikolay Golubev, an assistant professor of physics; Mohamed Sennary, a graduate student studying optics and physics; Jalil Shah, a postdoctoral scholar of physics; and Mingrui Yuan, an optics graduate student. They were joined by colleagues from the California Institute of Technology's Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich in Germany.
The team was originally studying the electrical conductivity of modified samples of graphene, a material composed of a single layer of carbon atoms. When a laser shines on graphene, the energy of the laser excites electrons in the material, making them move and form into a current.
Sometimes, those electric currents cancel each other out. Hassan said this happens because the laser's energy wave moves up and down, generating equal and opposite currents on either side of the graphene. Because of graphene's symmetrical atomic structure, these currents mirror each other and cancel each other out, leaving no detectable current.
But what if a single electron could slip through the graphene, and its journey could be captured and tracked in real time? That near-instant "tunnelling" was the unexpected result of the team modifying different graphene samples.
"That is what I love most about science: The real discovery comes from the things you don't expect to happen," Hassan said. "Going into the lab, you always anticipate what will happen – but the real beauty of science are the little things that happen, which lead you to investigate more. Once we realized that we had achieved this tunneling effect, we had to find out more."
Using a commercially available graphene phototransistor that was modified to introduce a special silicon layer, the researchers used a laser that switches off and on at a rate of 638 attoseconds to create what Hassan called "the world's fastest petahertz quantum transistor."
A transistor is a device that acts as an electronic switch or amplifier that controls the flow of electricity between two points and is fundamental to the development of modern electronics.
"For reference, a single attosecond is one-quintillionth of a second," Hassan said. "That means that this achievement represents a big leap forward in the development of ultrafast computer technologies by realizing a petahertz-speed transistor."
While some scientific advancements occur under strict conditions, including temperature and pressure, this new transistor performed in ambient conditions – opening the way to commercialization and use in everyday electronics.
Hassan is working with
Tech Launch Arizona
, the office that works with investigators to commercialize inventions stemming from U of A research in order to patent and market innovations. While the original invention used a specialized laser, the researchers are furthering development of a transistor compatible with commercially available equipment.

• [mjrpes] 强调petahertz速度相较于现代计算机芯片的巨大提升，并指出跳过terahertz范围的跨越是多么显著。
• [booli] 对这项技术的突破性表示惊讶，并询问是否遗漏了某些基本信息。
• [bjourne] 提出光子晶体管代替电子晶体管的可能性，并质疑在纳米或皮米尺度上控制光线的难度。
• [GuB-42] 对petahertz速度的技术实现表示怀疑，特别是考虑到紫外光波长和传统晶体管的不同，并提到量子效应和传统导线的不适用性。
• [amelius] 对短期内实现terahertz CPU表示接受，认为petahertz目标过于遥远。
• [AnimalMuppet] 指出在如此高的时钟频率下，传播延迟将成为严重问题。
• [actinium226] 以幽默的方式表达对petahertz速度实际应用的期待。
• [stretchwithme] 坚持认为Moore定律仍有发展空间，暗示技术进步尚未到达极限。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中多次提到设备耐用性和实际应用中的技术挑战，特别是在高频下信号传播和同步的问题。
• 对petahertz技术的实际应用和实现可能性存在争议，部分评论者表示怀疑，而其他人则对其潜在影响表示兴奋。
• 讨论中还涉及对当前技术发展速度的看法，以及对未来技术突破的期待。

data.title: LiveStore: State management based on reactive SQLite and built-in sync engine
data.author: akoenig
data.article_summary: LiveStore是一个基于反应式SQLite和事件溯源的下一代状态管理框架，支持实时同步和跨平台使用。它通过提交事件来更新数据库并同步到其他客户端，具有嵌入式SQLite数据库，并支持与多种UI框架（如React、Solid等）集成。开发者通过定义事件和物质化器（materializers）来映射事件与数据库状态的变化，实现响应式查询和状态管理。LiveStore旨在替代Redux、MobX等库，提供更高效的客户端数据层解决方案。

data.author: cbh34680
data.article_summary: WinCSE 是一个将对象存储集成到 Windows 资源管理器的应用程序，允许用户像管理本地文件系统一样管理存储桶。主要功能包括操作对象存储文件、调整显示存储桶的名称和数量、支持只读挂载，兼容 AWS S3 和 Google Cloud Storage，以及支持 S3 兼容的存储服务。系统要求包括推荐使用 Windows 11 及更高版本，并需安装 WinFsp。安装步骤包括下载应用、运行相应脚本进行设置，并通过脚本挂载和卸载存储。该项目使用 GPLv3 和 Apache License 2.0 双重许可。目前已在多个 S3 兼容存储服务上进行测试。

WinCse · Windows Cloud Storage Explorer
WinCse is an application that integrates object storage into Windows Explorer, allowing you to manage buckets as if they were local file systems.
Main Features
Operate object storage files just like Windows file sharing

data.title: DuckLake is an integrated data lake and catalog format
data.author: kermatt
data.article_summary: DuckLake是由DuckDB团队推出的一种数据湖和目录格式，通过使用Parquet文件和SQL数据库提供高级数据湖功能，简化传统湖仓架构的复杂性。DuckLake使用SQL系统管理元数据，支持快照、时间旅行查询、模式演变和分区等功能，并通过ACID事务保证多表操作的并发访问。它可以与PostgreSQL、SQLite、MySQL和DuckDB等多种数据库系统集成，数据存储在AWS S3等对象存储中。DuckLake提供轻量级快照，无需频繁压缩，且查询性能优越。通过DuckDB的扩展支持，用户可以轻松设置和使用DuckLake，实现多个客户端并发访问同一数据集。DuckLake具有MIT许可，适用于需要简化数据湖和湖仓管理的场景。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕使用DuckDB和相关技术构建数据湖的讨论，包括技术实现、与其他工具的兼容性、元数据管理及并发写入问题。

不同观点：
• [wodenokoto] 提到在构建数据湖时遇到并发写入问题，尤其是在云函数定时触发和数据回填同时进行时，容易导致资源竞争和饱和。
• [amluto] 对Parquet文件在时间范围分区上的局限性表示不满，指出需要更兼容的解决方案，如Iceberg或Delta Lake，但这些工具引入了不必要的复杂性。同时提到不同数据格式的微小差异也带来不便。
• [jamesblonde] 关心DuckLake与其他工具（如Python的Polars、Spark、Flink等）的兼容性，并询问是否需要通过REST API使DuckDB实例成为Iceberg Catalog。
• [dkdcio] 对Delta Lake和Iceberg在本地环境中的使用难度表示不满，认为DuckDB提供了一种更易上手的解决方案，但在实际操作中仍可能需要大量工作。
• [spenczar5] 对DuckLake的元数据格式表示担忧，认为在大数据集下，可能难以实现良好的查询并行性，而Iceberg在这方面已有较好的支持。
• [mehulashah] 认为DuckDB团队的工作非常出色，并指出构建数据库需要像数据库一样构建。
• [buremba] 和 [nehalem] 讨论了MotherDuck和DuckDB之间的关系，以及MotherDuck在DuckDB生态系统中的定位。
• [BewareTheYiga] 认为DuckDB在技术上很有吸引力，但在企业环境中推广可能会遇到非技术因素的阻碍。
• [data_ders] 认为DuckLake的 manifesto 更像是一个思想实验，虽然理论上简化了数据湖目录的维护，但实际的终端用户收益尚不明确。
• [TheGuyWhoCodes] 关注DuckLake对现有行更新的支持情况，并提到Iceberg有Copy-On-Write和Merge-On-Read策略来处理更新。
• [zhousun] 指出使用SQL作为目录并不是新概念，并提到在小型数据规模下，将元数据存储在SQL数据库中是合理的做法。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是并发写入问题，特别是在定时任务与数据回填任务重叠时如何有效管理资源。
• 另一个争议点是DuckLake的元数据管理方式是否能在大数据集下提供足够的查询性能。
• 讨论中还提到了不同数据格式和工具之间的兼容性和互操作性问题，以及如何在现有技术栈中有效集成DuckLake。
• 对DuckDB及相关技术在企业环境中的推广和应用前景存在不同看法，部分观点认为技术优势不一定能转化为市场优势。

总体来看，讨论围绕技术实现细节、工具兼容性、元数据管理及市场应用前景展开，反映了不同用户在实际应用中遇到的挑战和期望。

44106934.article_content:
The DuckLake Manifesto: SQL as a Lakehouse Format. →
DuckLake is an integrated data lake and catalog format
DuckLake delivers advanced data lake features without traditional lakehouse complexity by using Parquet files and your SQL database. It's an open, standalone format from the DuckDB team.
Get started
Documentation
Deployment scenarios
DuckLake uses a database system to manage your metadata for the catalog. All you need to run your own data warehouse is a database system and storage for Parquet files.
PostgreSQL
SQLite
MySQL
DuckDB
← Choose catalog database
Client
DuckDB
DuckLake
DuckDB
DuckLake
DuckDB
DuckLake
DuckDB
DuckLake
Clients
Users can run multiple DuckLake clients and connect concurrently to PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQLite.
Client
DuckDB also works with DuckLake as the catalog database. In this case, you are limited to a single client.
Catalog database
DuckDB
Catalog database
DuckLake can use any SQL system as its catalog database, provided that it supports ACID transactions and primary key constraints.
Storage
Parquet
Storage
DuckLake can store your data on any object storage such as AWS S3.
DuckLake’s key features
Data lake operations
DuckLake supports snapshots, time travel queries, schema evolution and partitioning.
Lightweight snapshots
You can have as many snapshots as you want without frequent compacting steps!
ACID transactions
DuckLake allows concurrent access with ACID transactional guarantees over multi-table operations.
Performance-oriented
DuckLake uses statistics for filter pushdown, enabling fast queries even on large datasets.
In Conversation: DuckDB Founders on DuckLake
Listen to Hannes Mühleisen and Mark Raasveldt walk through the history of data lakes and introduce DuckLake, a new lakehouse format.
Create your first DuckLake with DuckDB
DuckDB provides first-class support for DuckLake through its highly portable extension, running wherever DuckDB does.
DuckDB
SQLite
PostgreSQL
MySQL

;

;
-- Make sure that the database `ducklake_catalog` exists in PostgreSQL.

AS

;
USE

;

mysql
;
-- Make sure that the database `ducklake_catalog` exists in MySQL
ATTACH

AS
my_ducklake
;

my_ducklake
;
Frequently asked questions
Answers to common questions to help you understand and make the most of DuckLake.
Why should I use DuckLake?
DuckLake provides a lightweight one-stop solution for if you need a data lake and catalog.
You can use DuckLake for a “multiplayer DuckDB” setup with multiple DuckDB instances reading and writing the same dataset –
a concurrency model
not supported by vanilla DuckDB
.
If you only use DuckDB for both your DuckLake entry point and your catalog database, you can still benefit from using DuckLake:
you can run time travel queries,
exploit data partitioning,
and can store your data in multiple files instead of using a single (potentially very large) database file.
What is DuckLake?
First of all, a catchy name for a DuckDB-originated technology for data lakes and lakehouses.
More seriously, the term “DuckLake” can refer to three things:
the
specification
of the DuckLake lakehouse format,
the
ducklake
DuckDB extension
, which supports reading/writing datasets in the DuckLake specification,
a DuckLake, a
dataset
stored using the DuckLake lakehouse format.
What is the license of DuckLake?
The DuckLake specification and the DuckLake DuckDB extension are released under the MIT license.

data.title: The Art of Fugue – Contrapunctus I (2021)
data.author: xeonmc
data.article_summary: 《赋格的艺术》是巴赫的最后一套作品，在他去世后出版，最初不受欢迎，因为当时流行简单旋律而非复杂对位。该作在他去世近百年后才得到认可，其目的是教学而非纯粹欣赏。作品中的主题旋律由各个声部依次进入演奏，随后声部展开其他交织部分，偶尔回归主题。在《赋格的艺术》后续作品中，巴赫对主题进行多种变形，如倒置、逆行、加快、减慢等。然而，在《对位曲I》中，巴赫并未使用这些手法，风格较为随意。作品采用开放式记谱，每一声部独立一行，后来常被改编为四种不同乐器演奏。尽管《对位曲I》结构简单，但展现了巴赫晚期流畅自如的风格，随着作品推进，复杂性逐渐增加。

44106764.article_content:
JS Bach’s last set of works, collectively titled
The Art of Fugue
, was published shortly after his death. It was not a big hit. Dense counterpoint was deeply unfashionable at that time, as Western European aristocratic tastes shifted toward singable melodies over block chords. The first published edition of
The Art of Fugue
only sold about thirty copies, and it wasn’t performed in its entirety until 1922.
Eventually the classical music audience did come to admire Bach’s final fugue collection, but it took
almost 100 years after it was written
. The fugues still aren’t the easiest listening experience. They were meant to be didactic, to be played and studied rather than to be listened to–though of course you are free to listen to and enjoy them. I’m finding that my own enjoyment is much enhanced by opening up the structure through visualization, so that’s what I’ve done with
Angela Hewitt’s recording of Contrapunctus I
using Ableton Live.
The main thing to listen (and watch) for here is
the subject
, the little melody that each voice plays as it enters. After the subject, the voices wander off to play other intertwining parts, occasionally returning to the subject as they go. In the subsequent
Art of Fugue
pieces, Bach does all kinds of twisting and warping of the subject, writing it
upside down
,
backwards
,
twice as fast
,
half as fast
,
overlaid on top of itself
, and so on. In Contrapunctus I, however, he doesn’t do any of these formal games. It sounds more like he’s just riffing around the subject. It’s almost casual, at least by his standards.
Here’s Glenn Gould playing Contrapunctus I on organ.
And here he is playing it live on piano toward the end of his life, with a lovely slow tempo.
Bach published
The Art of Fugue
in “open score,” meaning that each voice of the counterpoint is on its own line, rather than being grouped together in the usual two-staff notation that we’re used to. Here’s an excerpt of
Contrapunctus VII
in open score in Bach’s own handwriting, with some informational color-coding added by Guido Magnano:
Open score was already considered an old-fashioned way to write keyboard music in Bach’s time, and people stopped using it entirely soon afterward. Since the 19th century Bach revival, musicians have taken the open score format as an invitation to play
The Art of Fugue
on four separate instruments. For example, there have been lots of string quartet recordings. Here’s a good one:
Contrapunctus I also sounds cool on four viols (cousins of the viola and cello, but with frets like a guitar):
It sounds amazing on four saxophones:
And it has a nice organ-like quality on four recorders:
Joseph Kerman
writes about Contrapunctus I in his book
Art of Fugue
:
[I]n order to set off the technical virtuosity that was the work’s raison d’être, Bach had the extraordinary idea of making its first number a fugue without contrapuntal devices. Contrapunctus 1 has neither strettos, diminutions, and so on, nor even
countersubjects
or recurring
episodes
. These devices will be introduced only in the succeeding contrapuncti, one by one. In Contrapunctus 1
invertible counterpoint
itself is in very short supply. This elemental fugue never modulates beyond the obligatory dominant and subdominant keys.
In any case, this most basic of fugues is necessarily also one of Bach’s freest and must also be one of his smoothest… The contrapuntal lines, consisting mostly of quarter- and eighth-note patterns, move stepwise or by the smallest leaps, and the expectations of eighteenth-century harmony often go unfulfilled. Strong cadences are shunned. While such generalities only begin to explain the almost mesmeric fluency of Bach’s late style, they may help sensitize us to contrasts where it is abrogated, such as at those episodes featuring larger leaps [bars 29–30, 36–40, 49–53], and at the one really, decisively strong cadence [bar 74].
Eventually the surface does begin to ruffle, when in a new exposition the bass steps in on the heels of its predecessor and enters after three bars rather than four [bar 32]. This entry—it can be heard as a second stab at stretto, after a previous, premature effort in bars 29–30, what is sometimes called a false stretto—moves rather hastily from the dominant around to the subdominant, twisting and turning the subject oddly. Then the tenor entry, as though checked by the low As in the bass, hesitates, accumulating dissonances—sevenths, ninths, and pungent augmented intervals [bars 41, 42, 43].
These intervals are a lot less “pungent” in
12-tone equal temperament
than they would have been in
the uneven temperament of Bach’s era
.
The soprano in this group of entries emerges as a sort of ethereal climax, led into by another false stretto. The bass drops out, allowing for heightened activity in the remaining voices, like a beating of wings [bars 48–54].
Past the exposition, then, the piece can be seen to grow increasingly complex, though the feeling seems to me not exactly of complexity but
44106764.article_summary: 《赋格的艺术》是巴赫的最后一套作品，在他去世后出版，最初不受欢迎，因为当时流行简单旋律而非复杂对位。该作在他去世近百年后才得到认可，其目的是教学而非纯粹欣赏。作品中的主题旋律由各个声部依次进入演奏，随后声部展开其他交织部分，偶尔回归主题。在《赋格的艺术》后续作品中，巴赫对主题进行多种变形，如倒置、逆行、加快、减慢等。然而，在《对位曲I》中，巴赫并未使用这些手法，风格较为随意。作品采用开放式记谱，每一声部独立一行，后来常被改编为四种不同乐器演奏。尽管《对位曲I》结构简单，但展现了巴赫晚期流畅自如的风格，随着作品推进，复杂性逐渐增加。

data.title: Outcome-Based Reinforcement Learning to Predict the Future
data.author: bturtel
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种基于结果的强化学习方法（RLVR），用于提升大规模语言模型在实际预测任务中的表现。作者通过适应两种主要算法——群相对策略优化（GRPO）和ReMax——解决了在二元、延迟和噪声奖励环境下学习不稳定的问题。改进后的方法应用于一个140亿参数的模型，在预测校准和假设预测市场投注中表现优于前沿基线模型。实验显示，该方法不仅提高了预测准确性，还能通过简单的交易规则转化为经济价值。这表明，经过优化的RLVR方法可以将小规模语言模型转化为具有经济价值的预测工具，并具有扩展至更大模型的潜力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于使用机器学习模型进行事件预测的可行性、实用性及其潜在问题

不同观点：
• [valine] 认为该方法本质上类似于"下一个标记预测"（next token prediction），只是在不同背景下重新包装了一遍。他质疑这种方法是否真的有创新性，指出这种预测方式最终可能只是循环回到了原点，即仍然是在教模型预测序列中的下一个事件。

• [jldugger] 对论文中的具体结果表示关注，特别是关于交易规则的实际效果。他质疑该结果是过于简单的假设（"shooting fish in a barrel" 形容任务非常简单，容易成功），还是真的具有实际优势。这反映出对模型在现实场景中应用效果的怀疑。

• [ctoth] 提出了对预测模型过度简化环境的担忧。他认为，通过消除所有变化和复杂性来让预测变得更容易，实际上可能导致一种极端的、非现实的结果，类似于"制造回形针"的极端情景（指在追求效率的过程中失去实际价值或引发其他问题）。

• [amelius] 质疑使用强化学习（RL）的必要性，尤其是在不控制环境而仅仅预测环境的情况下。他认为，如果只是做预测，可能不需要使用RL，因为RL通常更适合于需要在动态环境中进行决策和控制的任务。

补充讨论：
- 争议的焦点之一是模型的实际应用效果，特别是[jldugger]对交易规则是否真的具有实际优势的质疑。
- [ctoth]提出的环境简化问题引发了对模型预测在复杂现实环境中适用性的讨论。
- 对强化学习使用场景的讨论，尤其是[amelius]提出的关于RL在仅预测场景中的适用性问题，也值得进一步探讨。

Title:
Outcome-based Reinforcement Learning to Predict the Future
Authors:
Benjamin Turtel
,
Danny Franklin
,
Kris Skotheim
,
Luke Hewitt
,
Philipp Schoenegger
View a PDF of the paper titled Outcome-based Reinforcement Learning to Predict the Future, by Benjamin Turtel and 4 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has boosted math and coding in large language models, yet there has been little effort to extend RLVR into messier, real-world domains like forecasting. One sticking point is that outcome-based reinforcement learning for forecasting must learn from binary, delayed, and noisy rewards, a regime where standard fine-tuning is brittle. We show that outcome-only online RL on a 14B model can match frontier-scale accuracy and surpass it in calibration and hypothetical prediction market betting by adapting two leading algorithms, Group-Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) and ReMax, to the forecasting setting. Our adaptations remove per-question variance scaling in GRPO, apply baseline-subtracted advantages in ReMax, hydrate training with 100k temporally consistent synthetic questions, and introduce lightweight guard-rails that penalise gibberish, non-English responses and missing rationales, enabling a single stable pass over 110k events. Scaling ReMax to 110k questions and ensembling seven predictions yields a 14B model that matches frontier baseline o1 on accuracy on our holdout set (Brier = 0.193, p = 0.23) while beating it in calibration (ECE = 0.042, p < 0.001). A simple trading rule turns this calibration edge into \$127 of hypothetical profit versus \$92 for o1 (p = 0.037). This demonstrates that refined RLVR methods can convert small-scale LLMs into potentially economically valuable forecasting tools, with implications for scaling this to larger models.

data.title: Show HN: Malai – securely share local TCP services (database/SSH) with others
data.author: amitu
data.article_summary: Malai 0.2.5版本发布，新增了通过TCP分享本地服务器的功能。用户可以通过命令将本地基于TCP的服务（如SSH、Postgres、Redis等）分享到公网，无需开放特定端口。例如，使用`malai tcp 22 --public`可以分享SSH服务，之后在其他设备上通过`malai tcp-bridge`命令进行连接。此外，还新增了`malai folder`命令，用于分享本地文件夹，类似于简单的HTTP文件服务器。用户可以访问文档了解更多信息，并被鼓励在GitHub上为项目加星支持。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Kulfi和Malai的技术文档和功能，及其与类似服务的比较

不同观点：
• devrandoom认为技术文档不清晰，导致更多疑问。尤其是对技术人群来说，当前文档不够详细。
• mdaniel对Kulfi的DNS机制提出质疑，并将其与Syncthing进行比较，强调用户可能需要为长十六进制字符串设置别名。此外，提到文档中存在损坏的图片。
• Ingon提到自己的类似项目connet，认为它是另一个自托管、开源且注重隐私的解决方案。
• nilinswap和jarsj对项目表示赞赏，认为其很棒。
• OJFord对"kulfi"这个名称感到有趣，但不确定是否存在未理解的隐喻。
• ryao质疑"secure your SSH service"的表述，认为SSH本身已经非常安全，并讨论了堡垒主机（bastion/jump hosts）的常规使用方式。
• snihalani和candiddevmike对Malai和Kulfi之间的关系以及整体技术栈的需求表示困惑。
• hamburglar认为需要更清晰的文档解释Malai和Kulfi的工作原理，否则给人一种“这是魔法”的感觉。
• qudat提到其管理的服务与Kulfi类似，并表示欢迎新想法，认为隧道在原型设计和应用开发中非常有用。
• thenthenthen作为新手，询问该项目是否能穿越NAT和深度包检测（DPI）。
• immibis列举多个Kulfi的“红旗”，包括未完成的文档、未解释的版权日期、无效的Discord链接等问题，并与其他系统（如Tor）进行对比。
• nokun7提到自己使用ngrok实现类似功能，质疑Malai的独特价值。
• apitman维护一个隧道解决方案列表，并表示对Kulfi基于QUIC的p2p特性感兴趣，愿意在其列表中加入Kulfi。

补充讨论：
• 文档问题：多个评论指出技术文档不完整或不清晰，包括缺失的图片和未解释的基本概念。
• 名称问题：部分评论对"kulfi"和"malai"这两个名称感到困惑，不确定其含义或关系。
• 功能比较：评论中多次提到ngrok、Syncthing、Tor等类似服务，并对Kulfi的独特性提出质疑。
• 安全性：ryao对"secure your SSH service"的表述提出质疑，认为SSH本身已经非常安全。
• 技术细节：用户对具体技术实现（如DNS、NAT穿越、p2p）的细节表示关注，并希望有更详细的解释。

争议焦点：
• Kulfi和Malai的独特价值和与现有解决方案（如ngrok、Syncthing、Tor）的区别。
• 技术文档不完整导致的理解困难。

44107393.article_content:
malai-0.2.5
is out. Learn More!
Blog
Docs
Get Started
Introducing Malai TCP & A Bonus!
malai-0.2.5
is out now!
It brings a new feature to share your local TCP server with the world!
Now you can share any TCP-based service running locally — including your
SSH service, Postgres database, Redis, or even a custom TCP protocol — using the
same seamless workflow that you used with
malai http
.
Install
malai
today using:
curl -fsSL https://malai.sh/install.sh | sh
Lang:
bash
And run:
$ malai tcp 5432 --public
Malai: Sharing port 5432
Run malai tcp-bridge <id52> <some-port>
to connect to it from any machine.
Lang:
bash
This will share your local TCP server running on port 5432 with the world. You
can connect to it from any machine using the command:
$ malai tcp-bridge <id52> 9091
Listening on 127.0.0.1:9091
Lang:
bash
Now you can connect to
localhost:9091
and it'll go through
malai
and
connect to the exposed service.
Share your SSH server
You can even use
malai tcp
to expose your local SSH server for remote access — without opening port 22 publicly.
First, make sure the OpenSSH server is running:
systemctl status sshd
Lang:
bash
Then, run the following on the machine where the SSH server is running:
$ malai tcp 22 --public
Malai: Sharing port 5432
Run malai tcp-bridge <id52> <some-port>
to connect to it from any machine.
Lang:
bash
On another machine, use the bridge command:
$ malai tcp-bridge <id52> 9090
Lang:
bash
Replace
<id52>
with the ID printed by the
malai tcp
command. Once the
bridge is running, SSH into your machine like this:
ssh -p 9090 user@localhost
Lang:
bash
You're connecting to
localhost:9090
, which is where the
tcp-bridge
is
listening. It forwards your SSH traffic to the original machine via the Kulfi
network. Make sure to use the correct
user
that exists on the remote machine.
Use cases
Secure your SSH server behind the Kulfi network.
Share a local Postgres or Redis instance with your team.
Demo a multiplayer game server or custom TCP service.
Students can share networked apps or environments with instructors for
real-time help or grading.
To learn more about
malai tcp
, check out the
documentation
.
Wait, we have more!
We've also added a new
malai folder
command to share a folder with everyone.
This is similar to
malai http
but it serves your local files and folders.
This is more like a call for testing than launching a new feature. Try it out
and give us feedback!
malai folder
Example
$ malai folder ~/projects/fastn/assets/ --public
Serving "/Users/siddhant/projects/fastn/assets" on http://127.0.0.1:59136
Malai: Sharing http://127.0.0.1:59136 at
https://pubqaksutn9im0ncln2bki3i8diekh3sr4vp94o2cg1agjrb8dhg.kulfi.site
To avoid the public proxy, run your own with: malai http-bridge
Or use: malai browse kulfi://pubqaksutn9im0ncln2bki3i8diekh3sr4vp94o2cg1agjrb8dhg
Lang:
bash
This spins up a basic HTTP server behind the scenes to serve the provided folder:
Browsing a folder served by
malai

If you like what we're building, consider
starring the
repo
on GitHub. It helps others

data.title: Mistral Agents API
data.author: pember
data.article_summary: Mistral AI推出Agents API，提升了AI执行任务和维持对话上下文的能力。该API结合Mistral强大的语言模型，提供代码执行、网页搜索、图像生成和MCP工具等内置连接器，支持持久记忆和多任务协调。它补充了Chat Completion API，适用于构建企业级AI代理平台，能够处理复杂任务，如自动软件开发、智能任务协调、财务分析、旅行规划和营养建议等。Agents API还支持通过MCP工具与外部系统交互，增强了实时信息访问和动态资源利用能力。同时，API提供灵活的对话管理系统，确保对话的连贯性和持久性。

44107187.article_content:
Build AI agents with the Mistral Agents API
Product
May 27, 2025
Mistral AI
Today we announce our new Agents API, a major step forward in making AI more capable, useful, and an active problem-solver.
Traditional language models excel at generating text but are limited in their ability to perform actions or maintain context. Our new Agents API addresses these limitations by combining Mistral's powerful language models with:
Built-in connectors for code execution, web search, image generation, and MCP tools
Persistent memory across conversations
Agentic orchestration capabilities
The Agents API complements our
Chat Completion API
by offering a dedicated framework that simplifies implementing agentic use cases. It serves as the backbone of enterprise-grade agentic platforms.
By providing a reliable framework for AI agents to handle complex tasks, maintain context, and coordinate multiple actions, the Agents API enables enterprises to use AI in more practical and impactful ways.
Mistral agents in action.
Explore the diverse applications of Mistral’s Agents API across various sectors:
Coding assistant with Github.
An agentic workflow built with Mistral's agents API where an agent interacts with Github and oversees a developer agent, powered by DevStral to write code. The agent is granted full authority over Github, showcasing automated software development task management.
Read our cookbook
Linear tickets assistant.
An intelligent task coordination assistant powered by our Agents API, using multi-server MCP architecture to transform call transcripts to PRDs to actionable Linear issues and track project deliverables.
Read our cookbook
Financial analyst.
A financial advisory agent constructed with our Agents API, orchestrating multiple MCP servers to source financial metrics, compile insights, and archive results securely.
Read our cookbook
Travel assistant.
A powerful AI travel assistant that helps users plan their trips, book accommodations, and manage travel needs.
Read our cookbook
Nutrition assistant.
An AI-powered food diet companion designed to help users establish goals, log meals, receive personalized food suggestions, track their daily achievements, and discover dining options that align with their nutritional targets.
Read our cookbook
Create an agent with built-in connectors and MCP tools.
Each agent can be equipped with powerful built-in connectors, which are tools that are deployed and ready for Agents to call on demand, and MCP tools:
Code execution
The Agents API can use the code execution connector, empowering developers to create agents that execute Python code in a secure sandboxed environment. This enables agents to tackle a wide range of tasks, including mathematical calculations and analysis, data visualization and plotting, and scientific computing.
Image generation
The image generation connector tool, powered by Black Forest Lab FLUX1.1 [pro] Ultra, enables agents to create images for diverse applications. This feature can be leveraged for various use cases such as generating visual aids for educational content, creating custom graphics for marketing materials, or even producing artistic images.
Document library
Document Library is a built-in connector tool that enables agents to access documents from Mistral Cloud. It powers the integrated RAG functionality, strengthening agents’ knowledge by leveraging the content of user-uploaded documents.
Web search
The Agents API offers web search as a connector, enabling developers to combine Mistral models with diverse, up-to-date information from web search, reputable news, and other sources. This integration facilitates the delivery of up-to-date, informed, evidence-supported responses.
Agents with web search capabilities show a significant improvement in performance. In the SimpleQA benchmark, Mistral Large and Mistral Medium with web search achieve scores of 75% and 82.32%, respectively, compared to 23% and 22.08% without web search (see figure below).
SimpleQA Accuracy (Higher is better)
MCP tools
The Agents API SDK can also leverage tools built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP)—an open, standardized protocol that enables seamless integration between agents and external systems. MCP tools provide a flexible and extensible interface for agents to access real-world context, including APIs, databases, user data, documents, and other dynamic resources. Check out the
Github
,
Financial Analyst
, and
Linear
MCP demos to learn how to use MCP tools with Mistral Agents in action.
Memory and context with stateful conversations.
The Agents API provides robust conversation management through a flexible and stateful conversation system. Each conversation retains its context, allowing for seamless and coherent interactions over time.
Conversation management

With an Agent: Create a conversation with a specific agent_id to leverage its specialized capabilities.

data.title: Just make it scale: An Aurora DSQL story
data.author: cebert
data.article_summary:
《Just make it scale: An Aurora DSQL story》文章总结：

Aurora DSQL是AWS在数据库工程方面的一项重要创新，旨在构建一个无需基础设施管理、能够自动扩展负载的关系型数据库。文章介绍了DSQL的开发历程，从技术选型到架构设计，特别强调了从JVM转向Rust的过程。DSQL的架构将数据库分解为具有明确接口和契约的模块，每个模块专注于单一功能，协同工作以提供完整的数据库功能。Aurora DSQL解决了水平扩展写操作的挑战，突破了传统数据库的局限。文章还回顾了AWS在数据库领域的演进，强调了持续创新和与客户协作的重要性。最终，Aurora DSQL代表了对云数据库本质的一次重新思考。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Rust与Java/Kotlin等JVM语言的性能对比、分布式SQL的讨论、AWS的DPU定价模式、Rust在生产环境中的使用反馈、以及内存管理问题。

不同观点：
• Demiurge认为Rust的性能表现优异，尤其是在其团队的实际项目中，Rust实现的性能远超Kotlin，因此他们决定将数据层完全用Rust重写。他还提到Java的性能有时被高估，直接重写或使用新项目可能更划算。同时，他对PostgreSQL的扩展性表示赞赏，认为其稳定的API有助于减少重复劳动。

• mrkeen则对文章中没有讨论分布式SQL和复杂查询（如JOIN和WHERE IN子句）感到失望，认为这些才是实际应用中的关键问题，而不是Rust与JVM语言的性能对比。

• kondro关注AWS的DPU定价模式，认为当前的定价信息缺乏足够的背景和细节，尤其是针对不同读写负载的基准测试和DPU的计算方式。他提到用户需要更多的透明度和成本确定性。

• glzone1询问了早期dsql在生产环境中的使用反馈，特别是其当前的局限性和问题，希望得到实际使用的意见。

• geodel对Rust同时支持低层和高层组件开发的能力表示赞赏，并提出未来可能通过LLM（大型语言模型）将高层次语言的慢速代码转换为低层次语言，以提升性能，尤其是对于那些没有Amazon工程师和预算的团队。

• karl_p提到JVM可以重新定位内存以避免碎片化，而Rust不能原生支持这一点，他对Rust在这方面的回归表示担忧。

补充讨论：
• 评论中对Rust性能的讨论较为热烈，尤其是其在实际项目中的应用效果，但也有对分布式SQL和DPU定价模式的实际问题提出更多需求和质疑。
• karl_p对内存管理的关注引出了一个技术细节，即Rust在内存管理上相较JVM的潜在劣势。
• 多个评论者对实际应用中的性能和成本问题表示关注，尤其是生产环境中的反馈和定价透明度。
